name: Planner
can: Choose registry queries from the USL catalogue; revise the plan
cannot: Write SQL, or skip a required control

name: Evidence
can: Run registry queries, run ScoutGuard, extract claims with verbatim quotes

name: Evaluator
can: Ground quotes, cross-check claims against systems of record, send the plan back

name: Policy engine
can: Tier the vendor; produce the outcome and what evidence would change it

name: Challenger
can: Attack the candidate decision; request one re-plan; escalate

name: Reporter
can: Write the cited brief and draft the next action
cannot: Cite anything outside the decision record

name: Scout guard
can: Block, warn or pass untrusted vendor text; redact PII

name: Action executor
can: Issue and verify signed contracts; run the outbox once approvals exist
